apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: vuoro-shared-db
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: clusters/main/kubernetes/apps/vuoro-shared-db/app
  prune: true
  wait: true
  timeout: 20m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: cluster
  dependsOn:
    - name: cloudnative-pg
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
      kind: Cluster
      name: vuoro-postgres
      namespace: vuoro-shared
    - apiVersion: batch/v1
      kind: Job
      name: vuoro-schema-grants-v3
      namespace: vuoro-shared
    - apiVersion: batch/v1
      kind: Job
      name: actionq-smoke-schema-migrate-v4
      namespace: vuoro-shared
    - apiVersion: batch/v1
      kind: Job
      name: vuoro-work-migrate-v25
      namespace: vuoro-shared
